integrity: All finite determinant and incidence certificates are reproducible using the standalone standard-library verifier; the infinite symbolic-degree formula has an independent nef-divisor proof. Only research-source priority checks and the stated self-review have occurred.
scientific_limitations: The prime classification is for the displayed primitive line equations over Z[phi]. The marked-point weights are section-collision counts and not lengths of the special-fiber singular scheme. The abstract eight-point Waldschmidt constant 7/3 was previously established by Huynh–Linh–Long (2024); only its connection to the icosahedral reduction and the characteristic-two explicit exact initial degrees are derived here. Other integral presentations may reduce differently. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Dyadic collapse and the thirty-one marked points of the icosahedral mirror arrangement
